The IBM Turbonomic REST API provides programmatic access to the Turbonomic Application Resource Management (ARM) platform. It enables automation of resource optimization actions, querying of entities (VMs, containers, applications, storage), management of markets and policies, retrieval of statistics and analytics, group management, template administration, and topology exploration across hybrid cloud environments.
